summary: Daytona Beach should keep a standalone municipal control row. Official city sources show an active Daytona Beach Police Department, and FDLE's official county-and-municipal offense reports publish Daytona Beach Police Department as a normal municipal row with substantive counts in 2020 and 2021. The current all-fill condition is therefore a reporting continuity and publication-ingestion failure on FL0640100, not an invalid target or sheriff-contract service-structure problem.
